children: Nicholas Conrad Smith, an insider and President And CFO, reported sales of Alto Neuroscience common stock under a Rule 10b5-1 plan adopted June 30, 2026. The sales were made at a weighted average price of $26.5826 per share for the largest tranche and at prices of $25.7786 and $26.87 for subsequent tranches. The total proceeds from the reported sales were $3,567,246. Following the transactions, the reporting person directly owned 24,060 shares of common stock.
